title: On a phone the field shows its arrow and opens its list without hover
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Create an open, uninvoiced work order for this test for that customer, with one approved labor line, one part and one "Sales Representative" field set to sales rep A.
  • Open the work order on a phone (a touch screen with no mouse pointer).
custom_steps:
1. Tap the card's edit button to expand it and look at the Sales Representative field without tapping it.
  2. Tap the Sales Representative field.
  3. Tap "Unassigned".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The field already shows its dropdown arrow, without any hover.
  • The + button shows beside it at its full size, without any hover.

Step 2:

  • The phone's own built-in list opens, the same kind Lead Technician and Service Advisor open on a phone.
  • "Unassigned" is first, then the sales representatives: the same options as on a desktop.
  • Sales rep A is checked.
  • There is no x inside the field.

Step 3:

  • The field reads "Unassigned".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11267 (Story 3, Set the representatives on a phone)

  • S3-R1: “Tapping a Sales Representative field opens the same dropdown Lead Technician and Service Advisor open on a phone, with the same options as on a desktop (S1-R8, S1-R9).”
  • S3-R3: “A field is cleared as on a desktop, by picking "Unassigned" (S1-R10). There is no x inside a field.”
  • S3-R4: “Nothing in the fields or the buttons depends on hover. On a touch screen the Sales Representative fields always show their dropdown arrow, as the + and remove x buttons always do. Lead Technician and Service Advisor keep today's behavior, where the arrow shows once the field is tapped.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 11: “11. (a) Always show the dropdown arrow, as the feature spec says.”
